- benchmark -> "reduce per-token inference cost"

seo-bot: crawl found duplicate titles at /old-launch/overview and /blog/2023. Recommend 301 -> /product/inference and add rel=canonical on blog. Also missing Event schema on webinar page.

maria: JSON-LD draft posted to page head.

devon: Draft rewrite rules ready. Will deliver final by 20:00 PT.

sam: HubSpot hidden fields ready for form (utm_source=webinar, campaign=launch_reliable_llm).

elaine: TL;DR owners and deadlines: redirects @devon by 20:00 PT, deploy @tyler 22:00 PT, keywords+JSON-LD @maria EOD, linking+UTMs @sam EOD. seo-bot will crawl tomorrow 06:00 PT and post results.
